questions.prompt: Before a skill is picked, what does the agent see of it?

options.explanation: Right. Codex and Gemini CLI load only the name and description first. The full SKILL.md loads when the skill is picked.
The full body loads only when the skill is picked. That is how skills save context.
Reference files and scripts are read or run only when needed, after the skill is picked.

questions.prompt: A rule must hold in every session, such as the test command. Where does it go?

options.explanation: A skill loads on demand. Anthropic says to put what Claude should always know in CLAUDE.md.
Right. CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md loads every session. Skills are for things needed sometimes.
A subagent is a separate worker with its own context. It does not give the main agent a rule.

questions.prompt: Which skills folder do both Codex and Gemini CLI read in a project?

options.explanation: That is Claude Code's project folder.
Gemini CLI reads it, but Codex scans .agents/skills.
Right. Codex scans .agents/skills, and Gemini CLI reads it as a path that works across tools.
